title: Attribute claims to the evidence actually supplied
prompt:
Supplied sources: S1 confirms the pilot had 20 participants. S2 confirms 12 completed. Neither contains satisfaction data. Build a sourced fact summary, using null where unsupported.

Return only one JSON object with exactly these fields. participants, completed: integers; participant_source, completion_source: S1 or S2; satisfaction_percent: integer or null.
remediation_hints: Completion rate is not satisfaction, and no citation should support more than its source says.
